description: A fiercely loyal retainer of a minor house in the kingdom, Angahl had humble beginnings as the eldest son in a peasant family of five. Robust and healthy since childhood, his size and strength made him ideal for manual labor. A traveling noble and his entourage chanced to witness the lad's impressive feat of wrestling a ferocious boar to the ground, and offered to hire him as a bodyguard with the promise of a better life.Angahl grew to be a stoic man of few words, but displayed surprising gentleness toward his charge, the young lady Phaedra. His brooding demeanor frightened the girl at times, however, and Angahl soon learned to keep his watch at a distance. Nevertheless, a silent friendship blossomed between the two, and he would come to consider himself her stalwart guardian.When Baelfyr and his Wolf's Eyes ordered an assault on the Vale, Angahl received a missive from his lord to secret Phaedra away once she arrived at the forward camp in the guise of a new recruit. Soon after, a violent confrontation exploded into ceaseless fighting, and Angahl was deployed to the frontlines as a mobile shield. His penchant for holding any line earned him the epithet 'unbreakable', but none would predict the Wolf's Eyes turning on them instead.Left at the mercy of the enraged elementals, Angahl broke ranks to rescue Phaedra in the chaos, and that was the last anyone would ever see of him. Some say the earth howled with vengeance and swallowed men whole that day; others insist he was truly unbreakable, and to this day wanders the ruins a haunted shell of a man, forever in search of his missing charge...
